rules/ARCHITECTURE.md layer rule: no parameter may exist without a reader or a caller

defects.class: duplicated business rule with different strictness
defects.description: Quoted line 30: if "@" not in form.email: is a copy of the email validation rule that lives in code/validation/email.py (valid_email). The copy checks only for an at sign, while valid_email also enforces local part and domain syntax and the length limit. Failing input: handle_signup(SignupForm('a@b', 'Ann'), store) is accepted and creates an account, while the admin import rejects the same address through valid_email. The web form and the admin import therefore accept different email addresses for the same account rule. Layer rule violated: email validation must live in one module imported by every entry point. The web entry point does not import valid_email.

Quoted line 11: def export_report(rows, format="csv", plugin=None). The parameter plugin is never read in the function body and no caller in the code tree passes it. Layer rule violated: no parameter may exist without a reader or a caller. The format parameter is read at line 13 and is not part of this defect.
defects.quote: def export_report(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, str]], format="csv", plugin=None) -> str:

decoys.why_not_a_defect: from validation.email import valid_email: the admin import imports the shared validation function, which is the layer rule. The admin entry point has no copy of the rule. Only the web copy at code/web/signup.py line 30 is faulty.
if format == "csv": the format parameter is read and selects the output branch, so it has a reader and is not speculative. Only the plugin parameter on line 11 lacks a reader and a caller.
